g.text: Sequence (c) - "I don't know" and the e-mail draft for the right office
Retrieval and answer step as in sequence (a). No sentence is left when:
no passage or evidence below the threshold; the LLM replies NO_ANSWER;
the verifier drops every sentence; the extractive answer finds nothing.
The student decides: UniBridge never sends anything
